unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #51 "Consider a Nano (XNO) settlement leg: the block itself is the independently verifiable record you already anchor decisions to". Argued the decision-envelope reconciliation vs the rail still needs a facilitator/indexer; on Nano the block is the receipt — verify the exact payment with one block_info call, no relayer, no gas. Offered the live Vend endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/status, 0.0001 XNO) to test a decision-envelope against a real send block. Public research disclosed in the issue.
